digest.component_or_area: bridge state store format and ADR documentation
propositions: Four committed format changes to .bridge_state (A1, A2, A3, A4-2) require an ADR documenting each rollback boundary and the mixed-version read protocol.
Mixed-version protocol uses chronological max(new, legacy) reads and stops legacy writes only after direct deployment evidence; max is required because first-wins is unsafe.

A2-2 cutover gate requires A2-1 merged, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host-probe refresh with no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle before legacy writes stop.
Bridge state remains committed on-branch because ephemeral GitHub runners need durable state and epic 6c9c rejected off-branch relocation.
Measured marginal cost after A1 is 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB; 218 of 399 prev key sets are identical; assignee remains unnormalized because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape.
